name: STRIKE
title: STRIKE: Learning Visual State Transitions for Physical World Modeling
description: Predict scene changes through learned visual state transitions, then generate the intervening video.
alt: Published STRIKE comparison: a robotic gripper attaches to a cube before lifting it, using learned visual transitions.

name: S2Tok
title: S2Tok: Streaming 3D Gaussian Reconstruction with Persistent Spatial Tokens
description: Maintain persistent spatial tokens as new images arrive, then decode them into 3D Gaussians.
alt: Published S2Tok reconstructions of outdoor, indoor and AI-generated scenes from sequential images.

name: Building Rome
title: Building Rome from a Single Image
description: Generate complete indoor and outdoor scene meshes from one image using adaptive spatial chunks.
alt: Published Building Rome reconstruction of the Colosseum, shown with surface normals and a 47 metre height annotation.

name: ReMind
title: Teaching Video Generators to Remember: Eliciting Dynamic Memory for Out-of-Sight State Evolution
description: Video generation with memory that tracks how hidden states evolve through interruptions.
alt: Published ReMind overview of evolving scene states and memory across interrupted observations.

name: URoPE
title: URoPE: Universal Relative Position Embedding across Geometric Spaces
description: Relative position encoding that connects image tokens through camera geometry.
alt: Published URoPE concept figure connecting positions across views and geometric spaces.

name: SpectralSplat
title: SpectralSplat: Appearance-Disentangled Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting for Driving Scenes
description: Separate geometry and appearance to transfer lighting across reconstructed driving scenes.
alt: Published SpectralSplat reconstruction of a street scene.

name: UniQueR
title: UniQueR: Unified Query-based Feedforward 3D Reconstruction
description: Reconstruct scenes from unposed images using sparse 3D queries that generate Gaussians.
alt: Published comparison of pixel-aligned and query-based 3D scene representations.

name: LFG
title: Learning to Drive is a Free Gift: Large-Scale Label-Free Autonomy Pretraining from Unposed In-The-Wild Videos
description: Learn geometry, semantics and motion for driving directly from unposed video.
alt: Published LFG teaser showing observed and predicted scene geometry, semantics and motion.

name: AVoptim / MOISST++
title: Refining Ground Truth Poses in Autonomous Driving Datasets via Neural Rendering
description: Refine sensor calibration and ego-trajectories, and assess pose quality through complementary measurements.
alt: Published AVoptim pose refinement comparisons and evaluation plots.

name: 3DGS-Calib
title: 3DGS-Calib: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Multimodal SpatioTemporal Calibration
description: Use differentiable Gaussian rendering anchored to LiDAR geometry to calibrate cameras.
alt: Published 3DGS-Calib architecture from LiDAR geometry to camera calibration.

name: SOAC
title: SOAC: Spatio-Temporal Overlap-Aware Multi-Sensor Calibration using Neural Radiance Fields
description: Calibrate a multi-sensor rig using camera-specific neural fields and shared scene visibility.
alt: Published SOAC overview of neural scene fitting and sensor calibration.

name: MOISST
title: MOISST: Multimodal Optimization of Implicit Scene for SpatioTemporal Calibration
description: Jointly optimize a shared neural scene and the spatial and temporal alignment of cameras and LiDAR.
alt: Published MOISST sensor alignment and image/depth overview.
